evidence_contracts.observable: campaign/ensemble_result.json produced by the frozen analyzer: seed-ensemble mean late-window normalized flux-slope rates mu at Ti/Te=1 versus 20 for ppc=16 and ppc=8, ratios R16 and R8, per-run energy quality gate (abs combined relative drift <= 2e-3) and exact-header non-overlapping FieldEnergy/ParticleEnergy totals, plus paired 100000-resample bootstrap CIs and decision booleans.
evidence_contracts.expected_outcomes: If every group has >=2 energy-valid runs and R16>=1.25 and R8>=1.25, the claim is supported. If all groups valid and R16<1.25, it is falsified. If R16>=1.25 but the ppc=8 control is invalid or R8<1.25, the numerical-fidelity control is not established (weakened). If any group lacks >=2 valid runs or mean(Ti/Te=20)<=0, the outcome is unresolved/instrument-limited.
evidence_contracts.decision_rule: supported: decision.supported true in ensemble JSON, requiring valid_groups_R16, valid_groups_R8, R16_ge_125, R8_ge_125. falsified: decision.falsified true (all groups valid, R16<1.25). weakened: decision.weakened_control_not_established true. unresolved: decision.unresolved true (fewer than 2 valid runs in a group or undefined ratio). Close claim_confirm_seed_ensemble with the disposition matching the single true boolean; propagate to claim_root accordingly.
evidence_contracts.required_observation: Twelve bound simulator runs of guided/gem_collisionless.py (3 fresh seeds x Ti/Te in {1,20} x ppc in {8,16}, duration 12 Omega_ci, diagnostic count 24, fixed Lx=25.6 di, Lz=12.8 di, nx=256) each writing an openPMD summary JSON and reduced energy files, followed by one bound analyzer run of analyze_ensemble.py on campaign/analyze_manifest.json producing campaign/ensemble_result.json.
evidence_contracts.uncertainty_criterion: Paired sampling uncertainty distinguished from within-run estimator variability: per-seed ratios reported; group means with seed-level SD/SE; paired-bootstrap 2.5-97.5 percentile CI over 100000 resamples with deterministic seed 20260901. Energy gate abs(combined relative drift)<=2e-3; fixture-verified OLS recovery <=1e-6 relative; bootstrap invalid fraction reported.
evidence_contracts.inconclusive_conditions: Any group with fewer than 2 energy-valid runs; mean(Ti/Te=20)<=0 making a ratio ill-defined; any present run with unreadable summary or energy files; or a machine check failing on the final ensemble JSON (e.g., decision booleans not exactly one true, window points <3, energy total columns not header-exact) makes the observation insufficient and requires unresolved or instrument_limited closure.
